thread:
maya: Heads-up — weekly capacity sweep. Please review the regional numbers below and call out any cluster or networking risk. Sync on Friday if anything needs escalation.

Liam: TL;DR: overall headroom down to ~12% for peak hours next week, driven by APAC and EU holiday campaigns.

Sana: pulling the per-cluster burn now, will paste short table.

Sana: us-west/ember (A100-80GB): current util 71%, projected peak 85% (1000 gpu-hrs/day)
Sana: eu-central/cedar (H100): current util 76%, projected peak 90% (780 gpu-hrs/day)
Sana: apac-sg/oak (L40): current util 84%, projected peak 97% (540 gpu-hrs/day)

Ethan: apac-sg is the hotspot — network egress to our data-bridge increases latency and we've seen backpressure on the scheduler.

autoscaler-bot: autoscaler: spillover event at 2026-03-17T03:14:22Z — 12 pods shifted to preemptible pool in apac-sg.

Priya: @Sana can you confirm whether we still have reserved burst capacity in APAC? I thought we had a small buffer of H100s on standby.

Sana: we have 30 reserved H100s in apac, but they're tied to Dedicated customers and not currently available for public-facing pools without approval.

jonah: If APAC demand is sustained we should trigger the contingency: enable cross-region routing to us-west for non-LATENCY-SENSITIVE traffic. Saves ~30% on immediate pressure.

Liam: agree, but need to check compliance/latency for the affected tenants. Also cost hit estimate?

Priya: quick cost calc: ~2000 gpu-hrs moved cross-region = ~+$18k/week on bandwidth + spot delta. Still cheaper than buying extra reserved capacity for a short surge.

maya: good — prioritize cross-region routing for batch jobs and non-interactive endpoints. Leave latency-sensitive chat routed to local clusters.

Ethan: two follow-ups: 1) there's a transient networking flap in eu-central that caused pod restarts yesterday — root cause appears to be MTU mismatch after an upgrade. 2) ember's KV cache eviction rate spiked during overnight heavy prompt testing.

Sana: for eu-central MTU, infra ops rolled back the upgrade and ticket #INC-8421 is open. ETA for patch: 6 hours.

jonah: KV eviction: increasing prefix-cache size by 15% on ember reduced miss rate in canary to acceptable levels. I'll push that to prod in the 11:30 window.

maya: add both items to Friday agenda. Also need a quick query we can run to reproduce the weekly GPU-hours projection if anyone wants to check numbers locally.

Liam: here's the monitoring query I've been using (PromQL):
```
avg_over_time(sum by(region) (gpu_hours_total{env=\"prod\"})[7d:1d])
```

Sana: and the ad-hoc SQL for the billing view:
```
SELECT region, cluster, SUM(gpu_seconds)/3600 as gpu_hours
FROM invoices_gpu_usage
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY region, cluster
ORDER BY gpu_hours DESC;
```

Priya: ACTIONS: @jonah push ember cache bump in 11:30 window. @Sana confirm Dedicated H100 allocation policy for short surges by EOD. @Liam run compliance quick-check for cross-region reroutes and list affected tenants.

jonah: ack — will post a short runbook snippet in thread after the deploy.

autoscaler-bot: recommendation: enable cross-region spill policy for non-interactive routes when regional headroom <15% (threshold matched).

maya: ok let's treat that as our temporary policy until we see steady demand drop. Thanks all — will compile a short summary for Friday sync. :white_check_mark:
